capabilities: Scan vault markdown files for unchecked todos
Assign todos to team members via @mention syntax
Parse natural-language due dates from todo text
Show my, team, and member todos in live sidebar views
Export todo and recent-file snapshots to README.md files
disambiguation: Not a note packaging or export tool; it collects and tracks unchecked todos in sidebar views.
extras: Marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Todo collation with team management — an Obsidian plugin port of notepack-cli.
problem: Obsidian's task lists don't aggregate unchecked todos across the vault or support assignment to people and due-date tracking.

relations.evidence: an Obsidian plugin port of notepack-cli

summary: Todo tracker that scans vault markdown for unchecked todos, assigns them via @mentions, parses natural-language due dates, and shows them in sidebar views.
